Hi Laura,

Thanks for signing up for a private deployment evaluation — really excited to connect. I saw your note about regulated workloads and tenant isolation; we regularly walk customers through our Private/VPC and on-prem options for healthcare workloads.

Quick ask so we can make the first call productive:
- Who would you like on the call from your side (security/compliance, infra, product)?
- Do you prefer an ops/deep-dive (60 min) or a shorter product + compliance overview (30 min)?
- Any mandatory docs you'd like in advance (SOC 2, data retention policy, network checklist)?

I can do the following slots (PT):
- Wed 5/26 10:00–11:00
- Wed 5/26 15:00–15:45
- Thu 5/27 09:00–10:00

If none work, tell me a couple options and I’ll loop in Marissa (AE) and Dylan (Solutions) to coordinate calendar and evidence.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
SDR, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0108

P.S. If helpful I can attach a short SOC2 summary and our pre-demo checklist before the call.

Connor — thanks for reaching out.

Clearsafe is evaluating several vendors for a pilot that will involve PHI-like data in a dedicated VPC. For the first call we need:
- Security lead (I'll include our CISO and infra lead)
- 60-minute slot — we want to cover network/topology and encryption/KMS options
- Can you send SOC 2 type II summary and a short network checklist ahead of time? Also, do you support an air-gapped/on-prem install or is it strictly VPC?

Our timezone is EDT — the Wed 10am PT slot is 1pm EDT and looks good. Can you confirm attendees and send a calendar invite with a dial-in?

Thanks,

laura.simmons@clearsafehealth.com | +1 617-555-2222
